transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been feeling extremely depressed, sad, and just completely empty inside for the past month. It has been so hard to cope with daily life lately.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the opposite—unusually energetic, happy, or like you didn't need much sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I have never had periods where I felt unusually energetic, hyper, or felt like I didn't need to sleep. It has mostly just been the opposite for me.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event, loss, or major change in your life?
I can't recall any specific stressful event, loss, or major life change that triggered these feelings. They just seemed to develop and get worse on their own over time without any clear reason.
During this past month, have you had any unusual experiences, such as hearing voices when no one is around, or feeling like people are watching or plotting against you?

Yes, I have. I've been hearing whispering voices when I'm completely alone in my room, and it's really frightening. I also constantly feel like I'm being watched and monitored by people who are out to get me.
Have you ever heard these whispering voices or felt like you were being watched during times when you were not feeling depressed?

Yes, I have. There was a period of about two or three weeks where my mood felt relatively normal, but I still heard those whispering voices. Even though I wasn't feeling depressed then, I still constantly felt like I was being watched and monitored.
How long in total have you been experiencing these whispering voices and the feeling of being watched?
It has been going on for about a year in total now. It is just so exhausting and terrifying to live like this for so long.
During this past year that you've had these voices and feelings of being watched, how much of that total time have you also felt depressed?

I would say I've felt depressed for the majority of this past year, probably for about nine or ten months of it. There were only a few brief weeks here and there where the heavy sadness lifted slightly.
Have you been using any recreational drugs, alcohol, or prescription medications during this past year?
No, I haven't used any recreational drugs or alcohol at all. I also haven't been taking any prescription medications during this past year.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions, or had any major physical illnesses or head injuries recently?
No, I haven't been diagnosed with any major medical conditions or had any physical illnesses recently. I also haven't had any head injuries or anything like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to think clearly, or has anyone mentioned that your speech has been disorganized or hard to follow?

Yes, my mind has felt incredibly foggy and dazed lately, making it really hard to think clearly. I often completely lose my train of thought, and my family has told me that I jump from one topic to another. They say my speech doesn't make much sense to them anymore because of how much I drift.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a one-year history of psychotic symptoms (auditory hallucinations, persecutory delusions, and disorganized speech) and concurrent depressive symptoms that have been present for the majority of the total illness duration (9 to 10 months). Crucially, the patient experienced a 2-to-3-week period where psychotic symptoms persisted in the absence of major depressive symptoms, meeting the diagnostic criteria for Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type) and distinguishing it from Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features.
